name: Damai Entertainment Holdings Limited
summary: Damai Entertainment Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the content, technology, and IP merchandising and commercialization businesses in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company invests, produces, promotes, markets, and distributes entertainment contents comprising film, online drama series, and broadcasting and television programs, as well as short dramas for children; and operates film ticketing and technology platforms under Tao Piao Piao and Yunzhi names.
